Business consultancy

Planning a business launch in Pakistan

Before committing to a launch date, test the offer and work out what the first few customers will need from the business.

In this guide
Test one offerMap the first orderGive registration its own workstream

Test one offer

Speak to people in the audience you want to serve. Ask how they currently solve the problem, what they pay attention to when choosing a supplier and whether they would discuss a specific trial order.

Map the first order

Write down how an enquiry becomes a quote, an order, a delivery and a payment. Identify the people, equipment and time each step needs. Test that sequence with a small order and document the friction.

Give registration its own workstream

List the registration, tax and sector-specific questions your intended business structure raises. Confirm current requirements with the relevant Pakistani authorities and an appropriate local adviser. Allow time for the answers before making commitments to customers.
